key_insight: An LLM agent recovered defensible Urbach-energy estimates from failed spectral analyses while preserving valid results and withholding unsupported values.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive exception handling can reduce manual intervention in self-driving laboratories while keeping quantitative property extraction deterministic.
method: Run a predefined numerical-analysis script on each optical transmittance spectrum.
Use an LLM agent to assess spectra and fitting diagnostics, accepting valid results unchanged.
Retry recoverable failures with bounded fitting-parameter adjustments; return NaN when evidence is insufficient.
evidence_signal: Across 203 epitaxial β-Ga2O3 film spectra, the agent retained 183 baseline estimates, recovered 16 of 20 failures, and returned NaN for 4, with decisions documented in audit records.
watch_item: Evaluation was limited to one material system and measurement workflow; reliability on other spectra and fitting procedures remains unestablished.
paper_title: Autonomous adaptive spectral analysis with an LLM agent for self-driving laboratories
